title: Salesforce Developer
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with 30 years of experience, is seeking a Salesforce OEM Application Developer to support a US-based customer. This position collaborates with development teams in the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil, focusing on designing, developing, and maintaining a managed Salesforce OEM application.


This role is ideal for someone with deep Salesforce development expertise, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly in English.


About the Role:


As a Salesforce OEM Application Developer, you will work closely with product managers, clients, and internal teams to gather and refine technical requirements, translate business needs into robust application features, and maintain a secure, scalable Salesforce OEM solution. You will develop advanced functionality combining code and configuration, manage integrations and data migrations, troubleshoot application-level issues, and support packaging, versioning, and upgrades of the managed application.


Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop, and maintain a managed Salesforce OEM application using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and declarative tools.
  • Build advanced Salesforce functionality, including complex Flows, triggers, asynchronous processing, and Community/Experience Cloud implementations .
  • Architect scalable and secure solutions aligned with Salesforce OEM/ISV best practices , including multi-tenant considerations and upgrade-safe design.
  • Develop and maintain custom data models, integrations, and automation , ensuring performance, governor-limit compliance, and maintainability.
  • Manage data migration and transformation processes using Apex, ETL tools, and Salesforce APIs.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve application-level issues including Apex logic, automation conflicts, and deployment errors.
  • Build test classes with strong code coverage and participate in CI/CD and release management activities.
  • Produce and maintain technical documentation , including architecture workbooks, developer/admin guides, testing strategies, and deployment protocols.
  • Collaborate with Salesforce Administrators and customer technical teams to ensure correct configuration and extension of the OEM application.


Required Experience:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Systems Analysis, Computer Engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong hands-on Salesforce development experience , including Apex, SOQL/SOSL, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Proven experience blending programmatic development and declarative configuration for scalable Salesforce solutions.
  • Experience designing and implementing advanced Flows, triggers, and automation based on business rules.
  • Deep understanding of Salesforce platform capabilities, security, permissions, sharing models, and performance optimization .
  • Experience collaborating with stakeholders to design sophisticated user experiences across screens, records, and automation processes.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, version control, and modern release practices .
  • Salesforce certifications: Platform Developer I/II, Administrator or Advanced Administrator (Platform App Builder preferred).
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills in English.
  • Familiarity with C# and the .NET ecosystem for backend services or integrations.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with AI-assisted development workflows for code generation, testing, or documentation.
  • Prior experience building or supporting OEM/ISV applications , including managed packages, AppExchange distribution, or Salesforce Security Review preparation.
  • BS/MS in Systems Analysis and Development, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent.

title: Financial Planning Analyst
description:
Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!



About The Role


Strong financial analysis and forecasting enables Teachable to determine how best to deploy our resources to continue (and accelerate) our growth. The FP&A team oversees the company's financial well-being while supporting operational and business planning in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. We work hard to ensure growth is accurately projected and that our financial results are properly accounted for.

We’re looking for an Senior FP&A Analyst who can help assess the opportunities ahead of us and support all areas of FP&A. This position will be heavily involved in various finance needs of the company, such as data analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling. If you enjoy the challenge of transforming business questions into financial models, please consider joining our team!


Key Responsibilities


  • Own updating and forecasting of Teachable Monthly P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow statements.
  • Put together monthly reporting powerpoint presentations.
  • Own all aspects of SG&A expense, tracking, and reporting internationally for Teachable.
  • Provide full visibility and tracking of company unit economics, and help the business drive operational efficiencies. This includes working closely with cross-functional partners to set targets and monitor performance such as LTV/CAC.
  • Support the finance department with ongoing analysis and forecasting for individual products and the overall company.
  • As needed, work on a variety of ad hoc and special projects that may include product or feature launches, pricing changes, or assessing the viability of new opportunities.


Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree, preferred concentration in finance, accounting, management or related fields .
  • 4+ years of experience in strategic finance, FP&A, or investment banking.
  • Advanced Excel Skills such as Power Query
  • Proficient financial, analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • BI tooling (Sigma, PowerBI) and SAP experience a plus.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across multiple projects and a willingness to learn.
  • Eagerness to learn and make a meaningful contribution.
  • Excitement to work independently and chart your own course, while knowing when to seek guidance.
  • Fluent english is required.

title: Engenheiro de dados SR
description:
A Stone:

Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.


Como é ser um Egenheiro de Dados:

O Engenheiro de Dados será responsável por construir, implantar e otimizar pipelines de dados confiáveis e escaláveis, garantindo que os dados brutos sejam transformados em informações úteis e acessíveis para a tomada de decisões estratégicas e segmentação de jornadas no contexto de CRM. O profissional trabalhará em estreita colaboração com analistas de negócios e equipes de TI para suportar diversas iniciativas orientadas por dados.


As suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Criar e gerenciar pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT): Desenvolver fluxos automatizados e confiáveis para extrair, transformar e carregar dados de diversas fontes, utilizando ferramentas de orquestração.
  • Assegurar a qualidade dos dados: Implementar processos para monitorar a qualidade e a integridade dos dados, identificando e corrigindo falhas na estrutura para evitar comprometimento das análises e jornadas.
  • Otimizar performance: Monitorar o desempenho dos sistemas de dados e implementar melhorias para garantir o processamento rápido e eficiente de consultas e análises.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência em SQL (Procedures, DML, DDL, Pipelines) & Python.
  • Plataformas de Nuvem: Experiência com serviços de nuvem (GCP, Amplitude, Salesforce Marketing Cloud) para armazenamento e processamento de dados.
  • Ferramentas de orquestração: Airflow e Cloud Functions.
  • Engenharia de Software: Conhecimento em boas práticas de codificação, versionamento (Git) e testes.
  • Capacidade de Resolução de Problemas e Pensamento Crítico: Habilidade analítica para identificar gargalos, depurar sistemas complexos e encontrar soluções eficazes de forma proativa.
  • Comunicação Eficaz: Clareza para explicar conceitos técnicos complexos para públicos não técnicos (como times de negócios e gestão), e vice-versa, garantindo o alinhamento de expectativas e resultados.
  • Trabalho em Equipe e Colaboração: Atuar de forma integrada com engenheiros de dados, analistas e outras equipes, contribuindo para um ambiente produtivo e sinérgico.
  • Orientação para Resultados: Foco em entregar soluções de dados que gerem valor real para o negócio e impulsionam a tomada de decisões.


Jornada de Trabalho:

  • CLT: 8 horas diárias + 1h de intervalo | Escala: 5x2 Segunda à sexta - de 08h às 17h ou de 09h às 18h.


Modelo/Local de trabalho:

  • Remoto


Etapas do Processo Seletivo

✍Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!

Entrevistas com o time de People: Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.

Case/ Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.

✅Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.


Nossa Cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

title: Financial Controller
description:
Join a team that values you. At StaffRight, we connect talented professionals with global opportunities—and we’re growing fast! With competitive pay, health insurance, paid time off (including national holidays), and a supportive HR team always in your corner, you’ll love building your career with us.


The Controller is a hands-on, strategic finance leader responsible for overseeing all accounting operations across the company. This role ensures accurate financial reporting, strong internal controls, and scalable processes to support a growing, multi-brand food business.


The Controller partners closely with leadership to provide financial insights, manage cash flow, and support operational decision-making in a fast-moving CPG environment. This role is ideal for someone who is detail-oriented, highly organized, and comfortable operating at both the transactional and strategic levels.


This role is open to all candidates in the Philippines and all over Latin America.


What You’ll Be Doing:


Financial Accounting & Reporting

  • Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close process for all entities
  • Prepare and review timely and accurate financial statements including P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow
  • Ensure proper revenue recognition, inventory accounting, COGS, and accruals
  • Maintain and enforce consistent accounting policies and procedures
  • Manage the chart of accounts and general ledger structure to support brand-level and customer-level analysis


Inventory, Costing & Manufacturing Finance

  • Oversee inventory accounting for raw materials, work-in-process, and finished goods
  • Ensure accurate standard costing and variance analysis across materials, labor, and overhead
  • Partner with Operations to reconcile production, yields, and inventory movements
  • Drive accuracy and functionality of ERP systems, including Katana
  • Monitor and analyze margins by SKU, customer, and sales channel


Cash Flow, AP/AR & Controls

  • Manage cash flow forecasting and short- and medium-term liquidity planning
  • Oversee accounts payable and accounts receivable processes
  • Improve working capital efficiency including inventory turns, DSO, and DPO
  • Implement and maintain strong internal controls and approval workflows
  • Manage vendor payments, ACH and check processes, and banking relationships


Systems, Process & Scale

  • Own and optimize accounting systems and integrations including QuickBooks, ERP (Katana), and bill-pay tools
  • Improve automation, documentation, and repeatable finance processes
  • Prepare the finance function for audit readiness and future growth
  • Partner on system upgrades, implementations, and reporting enhancements


Compliance & External Relationships

  • Ensure compliance with GAAP and applicable tax and regulatory requirements
  • Coordinate with external CPA firms on tax filings, reviews, and audits
  • Support state and federal reporting requirements as applicable
  • Assist with insurance, sales tax, and other compliance areas


Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Manage and develop accounting staff or external resources as the business grows
  • Partner with Sales, Operations, and Supply Chain to provide financial insights
  • Deliver clear financial analysis to support pricing, promotions, and customer strategy
  • Act as a trusted financial thought partner to the CEO and leadership team


What We’re Looking For:


  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • CPA preferred but not required
  • 7+ years of progressive accounting or finance experience
  • Experience in CPG, food and beverage, manufacturing, or inventory-heavy businesses strongly preferred
  • Strong understanding of inventory accounting, costing, and margin analysis
  • Hands-on experience with QuickBooks and ERP systems
  • Katana experience is a strong plus
  • Proven ability to build and scale processes in a growing or entrepreneurial environment
  • Available to work in US time zones (Graveyard shift in the Philippines)
  • Available to start within 2 weeks from job offer


Technical Requirements:

  • Comfortable in using time-trackers (e.g. Time Doctor)
  • Own laptop/desktop, noise-cancelling headphones, and webcam
  • Reliable internet connection (at least 50 Mbps)
  • Available backup equipment in cases of power and internet outages
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and Google Workspace


Why You’ll Love Working Here:

Competitive Compensation

We offer a monthly salary based on your experience and qualifications. This is a full-time role requiring a 40-hour work week, and we make sure your expertise is valued and your contributions are fairly rewarded.


✈️ Paid Time Off and Sick Leave:

We believe in work-life balance. Enjoy generous paid time off and sick leave policies, allowing you to recharge, travel, or rest when needed—all while knowing your role is secure.

You are the kind of person who enjoys staying ahead of industry trends—especially in LLMs and generative AI—and bringing that knowledge into practical, production-ready workflows. title: Quality Analyst
description:
About us:


DTX Aerospace is a leading company in the aerospace industry. Known for its innovative approach and cutting-edge technology, the company specializes in the design, manufacture, and maintenance of Landing Gears. With a strong focus on quality and safety, we have established ourselves as a trusted partner to many major airlines and military organizations worldwide. We are committed to continuous improvement and sustainability, investing heavily in research and development to drive the industry forward.


About the job:


The Quality Analiyst will support the Quality Assurance team in our MRO facility, specializing in landing gear maintenance, repair, and overhaul. Reporting directly to the Quality Assurance Manager, the Quality Auditor is responsible for performing audits, inspections, and assessments to ensure compliance with aviation regulations, internal procedures, and customer requirements.


Audit & Compliance:

  • Conduct scheduled and unscheduled internal audits in accordance with the Quality Management System (QMS) and regulatory standards (e.g., FAA, EASA, ANAC).
  • Evaluate compliance of processes related to landing gear disassembly, inspection, repair, assembly, and testing.
  • Assist in preparing for and supporting external audits (regulatory and customer).

Inspection Oversight:

  • Review work orders, inspection records, and traceability documentation for accuracy and completeness.
  • Observe and assess maintenance activities for conformity to procedures and applicable standards.
  • Verify proper implementation of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).

Non-Conformance Management:

  • Identify and document non-conformances (NCRs) during audits or inspections.
  • Assist in root cause analysis and follow-up on corrective action implementation.
  • Track and report audit findings and trends to the Quality Assurance Manager.

Documentation & Records:

  • Maintain accurate records of audits, inspections, and findings.
  • Ensure all documentation complies with regulatory, customer, and company requirements.
  • Participate in the continuous improvement of procedures and forms used in the QA function.

Training & Communication:

  • Support ongoing quality awareness and training initiatives within the facility.
  • Communicate findings professionally and constructively to relevant departments and personnel.
  • Control technical training and training documentation for regulatory agencies and documents
  • Promote a culture of safety, quality, and compliance.


Work Experience:

Minimum 3 years of experience in MRO, preferably with aviation.

Experience in auditing, inspection, or quality control in an FAA or EASA-regulated environment.


Educational:

High school diploma or GED required; associate or bachelor's degree in Aviation Maintenance, Quality, or Engineering is a plus.

Technical Skills:

Working knowledge of aviation quality standards and regulatory requirements.


Soft Skills:

Strong attention to detail and analytical skills.

Effective written and verbal communication.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office and QMS-related software systems.

Ability to work independently and maintain objectivity in audits.


Full Time in Galeão - RJ.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job Description

About You

You are a Senior Data Engineer who enjoys building reliable, scalable data platforms and enabling data-driven and AI-powered products. You feel comfortable owning data pipelines end to end, working closely with analytics and AI/Data Science teams, and translating complex data problems into robust technical solutions.

You value clean architecture, performance, and data quality, and you’re curious about AI/ML integrations even if you’re not a model builder. You thrive in collaborative environments and can operate with autonomy while guiding best practices across teams.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field — or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, building and operating production-grade data pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL, including advanced joins, CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning.
  • Experience designing data models and analytical structures (dimensional models, facts, dimensions, SCDs).
  • Hands-on experience building ETL/ELT pipelines using modern orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, DBT, or similar).
  • Proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline development (PySpark is a strong plus).
  • Solid experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for data storage and processing.

  • Exposure to supporting AI/Data Science initiatives, such as data enablement for models, embeddings, entity matching, or advanced analytics (nice to have).

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with analysts, ML engineers, and product teams.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2+), able to work with global stakeholders.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ingestion processes supporting analytics and AI use cases.
  • Implement and optimize ETL/ELT workflows with attention to performance, reliability, and cost.
  • Design and evolve data models and curated layers to support reporting, analytics, and downstream systems.
  • Collaborate with analytics, AI/Data Science, and product teams to understand data requirements and SLAs.
  • Support AI and advanced analytics features by providing clean, well-structured, and reliable datasets.
  • Apply best practices around data quality, validation, monitoring, and observability.
  • Write maintainable, well-documented data code and contribute to shared standards and patterns.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and help improve overall data platform design.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

title: Azure Windows Solutions Architect
description:
Lead Azure & Windows Infrastructure Architect (POD 1 & 2)

Location: Remote / Hybrid | Experience: 13+ Years | Level: C5/C6 (Senior Leadership)

The Challenge

Are you a master of Windows ecosystems ready to lead the charge into the Cloud? We are looking for a Lead Infrastructure Architect to spearhead large-scale migrations for high-stakes industries like Banking, Healthcare, and Insurance.

In this role, you aren’t just a designer—you are the General of our Cloud PODs. You will lead a technical team of 5+ engineers, ensuring that complex legacy environments are modernized, secured, and migrated to Azure with surgical precision.

Your Impact

  • Architectural Sovereignty: Design the end-to-end \"Target State\" for massive enterprise environments. You will own the HLD (High-Level Design) and LLD (Low-Level Design) , ensuring every VM, Cluster, and Network packet has its place.
  • Lead the Squad: Act as the technical North Star for a team of 5+ infra experts. You will guide, govern, and mentor your team to deliver excellence under pressure.
  • Windows Modernization: You are the expert who knows Windows Clustering, DFS, and File/Print Services inside out. You’ll be the one to solve the \"impossible\" legacy issues during migration.
  • The Business Brain: You don't just build; you justify. You’ll use TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) and ROI metrics to prove to stakeholders that your architecture is the most efficient and cost-effective solution.
  • Mission Critical Support: You will oversee the stability of the environment, ensuring 24/7 reliability through robust Backup, DR, and Monitoring solutions.

What You Bring to the Table

  • The Veteran Background: 13+ years in IT with a deep focus on Windows Server and Azure IaaS/PaaS .
  • Migration Mastery: Expert-level experience with Azure Migrate for server consolidation and workload shifts.
  • Networking & Identity Guru: Deep knowledge of DNS, DHCP, WINS, and Azure IAM/Key Vault to keep our Landing Zones secure and connected.
  • Resilience Expert: Hands-on experience with Windows Clustering and Azure Site Recovery (ASR) for business continuity.
  • Strategic Communicator: You can navigate a 24x7 shift environment, manage customer calls with poise, and present complex solutions to C-suite stakeholders.

The Toolkit

  • Core: Azure Infrastructure, Windows Server (all versions), Azure Networking.
  • Leadership: Team Management & Technical Governance.
  • Compliance: Experience in regulated domains (SIAM, Data Privacy, Financial regulations).
  • Certifications (Preferred): AZ-305 (Solutions Architect Expert) or AZ-104 .

Why This Role?

This is more than a migration job; it’s a leadership opportunity. You will own the strategy for POD 1 and 2 , deciding how global enterprises evolve. If you enjoy solving complex \"under-the-hood\" Windows issues while simultaneously designing high-level cloud strategies, this is your next career move.

Ready to lead the migration? Apply now and let’s build the future of Enterprise Cloud.

What makes this version effective?

  • Directly addresses the \"POD\" structure: It makes the candidate feel like they are leading a specific mission.
  • Highlights the Hybrid nature: It acknowledges that they need to be good at both the new (Azure) and the old (Windows Clustering/DFS).
  • Emphasizes Leadership: By using words like \"General\" and \"North Star,\" you attract people who want to manage teams, not just configurations.

Na prática, é quem equilibra conceito de marca, arquitetura e execução propondo soluções inteligentes de layout, volumetria e materiais, detalhando com rigor técnico, compatibilizando marcenaria/serralheria/elétrica e garantindo que tudo o que é desenvolvido seja exequível, seguro e com padrão high-end.

Sênior

Tradução criativa de briefing e VT: Interpretar briefing, dados da VT e guides de marca, convertendo necessidades em soluções cenográficas com identidade, coerência estética e viabilidade construtiva.


Conceito espacial e solução criativa: Propor ideias de layout, volumetria, fluxos, pontos de destaque e materiais que elevem a experiência e reforcem a experiência da marca, considerando restrições reais (prazo, custo, montagem, ambiente, etc).


Estudos preliminares: Desenvolver estudos iniciais (layout, volumetria e alternativas) com rapidez e repertório, apresentando opções e racional de escolha.


Anteprojeto: Construir anteprojetos com definições de implantação, medidas, linguagem de materiais e lógica construtiva 3D, garantindo base sólida para orçamento e validação.


Projeto executivo e detalhamento: Produzir projetos executivos completos (plantas, cortes, elevações e detalhamento técnico), com clareza de montagem e precisão para produção.


Especificação de materiais: Especificar materiais, acabamentos e ferragens equilibrando estética, disponibilidade, custo, durabilidade e padrão high-end.


Normas e segurança: Aplicar normas técnicas e boas práticas de segurança/estabilidade, assegurando que a solução seja segura, montável e adequada ao ambiente.


Visitas técnicas e validação em campo: Realizar visitas técnicas aos locais de instalação para levantamento de medidas, identificação de restrições, validação de premissas de projeto e alinhamento com produção e operação.


Requisitos


  • Experiência prévia como projetista em projetos espaciais (cenografia, live marketing, arquitetura efêmera, ativações de marca ou similares).


  • Capacidade de propor soluções criativas de espaço (layout, volumetria, materiais) sem perder viabilidade e segurança.

title: Solutions Architect

  • Architect the Future: Conduct deep-dive \"AS-IS\" assessments and design sophisticated \"Target State\" architectures that get approved by executive review boards.

  • Be the Expert: Provide technical leadership in troubleshooting deep-stack issues (Networking, IO, Clusters) and define the BoM (Bill of Materials) to ensure clients get maximum value for their investment.

What We’re Looking For

  • The Veteran: 15+ years of IT experience, with at least a decade dedicated to the Microsoft Azure ecosystem.
  • The SQL Specialist: Deep, hands-on mastery of Azure SQL (IaaS & PaaS) , Azure Storage, and high-availability data solutions.
  • The Strategist: Experience in Business Continuity/Disaster Recovery (BCDR) and infrastructure-as-code principles.
  • The Communicator: Ability to bridge the gap between deep technical troubleshooting and C-suite stakeholder management.
  • The Industry Expert: Previous success navigating the regulatory complexities of the Banking or Healthcare sectors.

Technical Toolkit

  • Primary: Azure SQL, Azure Migrate, IAM, Key Vault, Storage.
  • Architecture: Mastery of Frameworks (TOGAF or similar), HLD/LLD creation.
  • Certification (The Cherry on Top): AZ-305 (Infrastructure Solutions) or AZ-104 (Administrator).

Why Join Us?

You will work on projects of massive scale where your designs directly impact the security and efficiency of global financial and medical data. This is a role for an architect who wants to own the \"Big Picture\" while staying sharp on the technical details.

Ready to build the next generation of Cloud Infrastructure? Let’s talk.

title: Remote Business Analyst
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples that models might get wrong, and You would articulate the correct answer & explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • English Proficiency: Ability to read and write in English with a high degree of comprehension skills.
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is preferred.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora Técnica de Soluções de Compliance
description:
Pessoa Coordenadora Técnica de Soluções de Compliance


O grupo RBNA Consult atua com certificações, auditorias e projetos de ESG, além de desenvolver softwares B2B. Dentro desse ecossistema, buscamos uma pessoa para liderar a parte técnica de Governança (G) , com foco em consultoria hands-on de compliance e apoio ao crescimento do nosso software.


O que você vai fazer


  • Conduzir projetos de consultoria e implementação de compliance, do diagnóstico à entrega.
  • Realizar gap assessment, plano de ação, desenho de governança, políticas, procedimentos, trilhas de evidência e suporte à preparação para auditorias.
  • Participar de reuniões com clientes junto da pessoa de vendas do nosso software, fazendo o papel de especialista técnico, ajudando no discovery, no desenho da solução e na proposta técnica.
  • Produzir materiais de apoio que acelerem a escala (templates, playbooks, checklists, metodologia, kit documental ISO 37001).
  • Apoiar o roadmap do software com insumos do campo, transformando dor do cliente em backlog claro para desenvolvimento, com priorização prática.


O que a gente procura


  • Experiência prática com compliance e governança, com atuação real em projetos (não só teoria).
  • Vivência com ISO 37001 , seja em implementação, auditoria, consultoria ou gestão de programa.
  • Boa comunicação com cliente, postura consultiva e capacidade de explicar assuntos complexos de forma simples.
  • Organização para tocar projetos com prazos, entregáveis e evidências bem estruturadas.
  • Capacidade de traduzir problema em solução, incluindo pensamento de produto (o básico para conversar com time técnico e ajudar a priorizar backlog).


Diferenciais


  • Experiência anterior em auditoria e consultoria (Big4 ou boutique) ou em setores regulados (energia, infraestrutura, logística, financeiro).
  • Experiência com canal de denúncias, investigações, due diligence e gestão de terceiros.
  • Familiaridade com softwares de GRC, LegalTech ou RegTech.
  • Inglês para reuniões e materiais.


Modelo de trabalho


  • Base: Leblon, Rio de Janeiro
  • Modelo: presencial


O que você encontra aqui


  • Autonomia real, proximidade com a liderança e espaço para construir método.
  • Projetos com impacto direto em clientes e no crescimento da empresa.
  • Um ambiente de startup , com decisão rápida e muita mão na massa .

title: Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required ⚠️


About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 8+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.


How to Apply


If you’re a Senior Product Designer with a passion for solving complex problems in the cybersecurity and SaaS space, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and Portuguese)

  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.

title: AI Video Ad Creator +  Copywriter + Visual Asset Designer
description:
The opportunity


We’re building a high-output creative engine for paid ads-and we’re looking for a specialist who can write the words that sell and turn them into scroll-stopping short-form video ads using AI video tools, strong editing, and performance thinking.


This is not a “make pretty videos” role. This is concept → copy → creative → iterations → winners .

If you live at the intersection of genAI + storytelling + conversion copywriting , this role is for you.


You’ll create AI-driven video ads and visual assets for campaigns across TikTok, Instagram Reels/Stories, YouTube Shorts, Meta, and more. We optimize for ROAS, CTR, CVR, hook rate, hold rate, and retention -and the copywriting is a core lever in every asset we ship.


What you’ll do


You own the creative from message to motion-including the copywriting .

Copywriting + creative strategy

  • Write conversion-focused short-form scripts (15-45s) : hooks, problem framing, proof, offer, CTA.
  • Create multiple copy angles per concept (pain-based, benefit-based, curiosity, contrarian, founder POV, social proof, demo-driven).
  • Write and version hook lines, VO scripts, on-screen text, captions, headlines, end-card CTAs , and thumbnail copy.
  • Translate product benefits into clear, punchy, platform-native messaging (no fluff, no generic AI-sounding copy).
  • Apply direct-response frameworks (Problem → Agitation → Solution, Before/After, Myth-busting, Objection handling, etc.) with modern pacing.

Video production + asset creation

  • Produce short-form ad creatives designed for conversion (tight cuts, retention-first pacing, pattern interrupts).
  • Create AI-generated video sequences and combine them with real footage/UGC where needed.
  • Generate visual assets for ad variations: thumbnails, product scenes, backgrounds, overlays, cutdowns, motion graphics, end cards.
  • Build multiple versions of the same concept (different hooks, copy angles, pacing, captions, VO, formats).
  • Work from a brief and deliver fast iterations based on performance feedback.
  • Maintain brand consistency while still pushing creative boundaries.
  • Collaborate with growth/marketing to align creative with testing strategy and learnings.


Minimum requirements (non-negotiable)


To be considered, you must meet the requirements below and include proof in your application:

  • Resume must be written in English.
  • You must share examples of your AI video ad work with VO and Dialogue (not just AI visuals).
  • Copywriting is required: you must provide evidence you wrote/owned the scripts and ad copy for at least some of the work you share (scripts, hook lists, on-screen text, captions, or a short case study describing your role).
  • You must provide at least ONE of the following:
  • Evidence you produced creatives that generated strong ROAS / conversion lift (screenshots, case study, or summary metrics), OR
  • A video you produced that achieved 10,000+ views , OR
  • Proof you can create complex AI short-form ad videos (not basic slideshow edits-think narrative, scene continuity, ad pacing, multiple AI shots, strong compositing).
  • You have managed or been part of a social media account with 10,000+ followers .


What “qualified” looks like (skills we’re actively looking for)


You don’t just edit-you communicate and convert.

  • You understand what makes a video ad perform: thumb-stopping hooks, clear messaging, pattern interrupts, pacing, proof, offer structure, CTA clarity .
  • You can write direct-response copy that sounds human, specific, and brand-right-not generic “AI marketing” language.
  • You can create AI-driven visuals that look intentional and brand-ready (not uncanny or generic).
  • You can edit like a performance creator: tight cuts, retention-first pacing, captions, kinetic typography, sound design.
  • You have a repeatable workflow to deliver high volume with high quality (and keep assets organized).


Tools & workflows (use what you’re best at)


We’re tool-agnostic, but you should be highly capable with several of the following:

AI + creative

  • AI video generation (e.g., Runway, Pika, or comparable tools)
  • AI image generation (e.g., Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Adobe Firefly, etc.)
  • Voice & audio (AI voiceover tools, sound design, music selection, cleanup)

Editing + delivery

  • Editing & motion (Premiere, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, etc.)
  • Creative versioning + organized file delivery (naming conventions, aspect ratios, exports)

Copywriting workflow (important)

  • You can work quickly in tools like Docs/Notion , and you know how to build:
  • Hook banks
  • Script variations
  • Angle matrices
  • Offer/CTA libraries
  • Caption + primary text variants aligned to the video


Deliverables & expectations


Typical output: 10 ad creatives per month (depending on campaign cycle), plus variations.

Format mastery: 9:16 primary , plus 1:1 and 16:9 cutdowns when needed.

You can deliver:

  • Final exports (platform-ready)
  • Project files when requested
  • Source assets used (AI outputs, overlays, audio references)

Copy deliverables (required):

  • Script + VO text (or structured script outline)
  • Hook variations (often 5-15 per concept)
  • On-screen text + caption plan (what appears when, and why)
  • End card copy + CTA variants
  • Optional: primary text/caption variants for Meta/TikTok where needed

Turnaround: fast iteration is key (often 24-72 hours per revision cycle , depending on scope).


How we evaluate success


  • Your creatives clearly map to an angle + message and drive action.
  • Iterations improve performance (hooks improve, retention improves, CTR/CVR improves).
  • Your output is consistent, organized, and easy to test at scale.
  • Your copy + editing work together (the words and visuals reinforce the same conversion story).

﻿

Compensation


Competitive and flexible based on experience and proof of performance.

Per project bases

If you’re a performance-minded AI creative who can write high-converting scripts and ship high-quality ads fast -and you have proof-apply with the items above.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Azure)
description:
About Us

Radity is a global software engineering company delivering innovative digital solutions to clients around the world. We are passionate about building great technology and fostering a collaborative environment where people grow, take ownership, and make a real impact.


We are currently looking for a DevOps Engineer experienced in Azure Cloud operations to join our remote-first engineering team. This position suits someone who thrives in building and maintaining large-scale infrastructure, ensuring performance and reliability, and communicating effectively with both technical and client teams.


Your Role

As a DevOps Engineer at Radity, you will manage, optimize, and automate Azure-based infrastructure. You will ensure the smooth operation of production systems, focusing on scalability, security, and monitoring. You will also work closely with developers and clients to provide technical clarity and maintain high service reliability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, and maintain infrastructure in Azure Cloud, including AKS environments.
  • Automate provisioning and system management using Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools.
  • Oversee system monitoring, alerting, and performance tuning using Datadog and native Azure tools.
  • Manage GitHub Actions pipelines for continuous integration and delivery.
  • Implement best practices for cost optimization, networking, and cloud security.
  • Collaborate directly with clients to support operational needs and technical planning.
  • Participate in troubleshooting, incident response, and infrastructure improvements.
  • Review application configurations and read Python-based code when required to support deployments.


What We Are Looking For

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in DevOps or Cloud Operations.
  • Fluent English communication skills, with the ability to interact directly with clients.
  • Strong expertise in Azure Cloud, AKS, and infrastructure as code.
  • Familiarity with Python, GitHub Actions, and Datadog.
  • Strong understanding of networking, security, and performance optimization.
  • A proactive and reliable approach to problem solving and ownership.


What’s In It for You

  • A remote-first position with flexible working hours.
  • Hands-on experience with advanced Azure technologies and global-scale systems.
  • Collaboration with international teams and direct client interaction.
  • A supportive environment focused on growth, quality, and innovation.
  • Opportunities for professional certifications and technical development.

Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our Client's growing team.

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in computer science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

  • Experience with version control systems, particularly Git.
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and tools such as Jira.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically about issues.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

  • Python experience building and consuming RESTful APIs.

  • Understanding of front-end technologies, such as HTML5, CSS3, and responsive design.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Serviços
description:
Resumo do cargo:

O Engenheiro de Serviços proporciona suporte técnico qualificado à base instalada do cliente, conseguindo a satisfação do cliente através da execução dos serviços e contratos de acordo com o escopo e orçamento definido.

  • Levantamento de dados, elaboração de fluxogramas , diagramas, memórias de cálculo e de estudos, visando a seleção do equipamento, material, execução de um projeto ou a adoção da solução mais econômica para resolução de problemas em instalações industriais de automação, existentes;
  • Elaboração de projetos básicos contendo Procedimentos Técnicos, Memoriais Descritivos de Construção e Montagem e de Memoriais Descritivos para Contratação de Projetos Executivos, obedecendo aos padrões da PETROBRAS;
  • Análise de projetos e estudos técnicos de outras empresas, bem como a emissão de Pareceres Técnicos (PATEC) de equipamentos e serviços que envolvam equipamento Emerson;
  • Serviços para configuração, programação e atualização (i.e. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);
  • Gerenciamento, monitoração e suporte para supervisórios da GE Digital (implementados ou não em conjunto com PLC da Emerson);
  • Elaboração, desenvolvimento e execução de projetos de migração de sistemas com equipamentos Emerson descontinuados (obsoletos);
  • Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, asim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson;
  • Comissionamento de novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial.


Quem você é:

Você toma ações consistentes para desenvolver novas habilidades. Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo. Você antecipa as necessidades do cliente e oferece serviços que vão além das expectativas dele. Você fornece informações úteis e no momento certo para pessoas em toda a organização. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam rapidamente.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Formação em Engenharia, preferencialmente Elétrica, Eletrônica ou de Automação;
  • Ter no mínimo 6 anos de experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore);
  • Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
  • Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office;
  • Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, VersaMax, QuickPanel+, Machine Edition e etc;
  • Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14;
  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
  • Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.

Nossa cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.

title: SAP S/4HANA Functional Data Consultant/Lead
description:
We are hiring for our North America Client

Remote role


Position Purpose:

Client is currently undertaking several large-scale global transformation projects.


Each of which requires conversion and migration of data, and ongoing process (reference, conditional, configuration, transactional, and etc..) data management. We are seeking

experienced SAP S/4HANA Functional Process Data Experts to support a global greenfield

S/4HANA implementation across all value streams (RTR, PTD, PLM, STP, OTC…business

processes.


This role is critical to ensuring that business data is fit-for-purpose, standardized, governed, and ready to enable successful process design, system build, migration, and adoption.


The Functional Process Data Expert will act as the bridge between business process

owners, functional SAP teams, and the data enablement organization, ensuring that data

requirements are fully embedded into solution design and execution.


Key Responsibilities

Data Enablement & Solution Design

• Partner with global and regional business stakeholders to define data requirements aligned to standardized value stream processes.

• Translate business process designs into clear master and transactional data definitions for S/4HANA.

• Support template design by ensuring consistent data models, attributes, and hierarchies across geographies.

Functional Process Data Ownership

Responsibilities include:

• Defining data objects, attributes, and mandatory fields.

• Supporting business rules, validations, and derivations.

• Aligning data structures to SAP best practices and industry standards.


Data Migration & Readiness

• Support data cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization activities.

• Define and validate data mapping rules from legacy systems to S/4HANA.

• Participate in mock conversions, data loads, and reconciliation activities.

• Ensure data quality thresholds are met prior to cutover.


Data Governance & Standards

• Support the establishment and enforcement of global data standards and policies.

• Work closely with Master Data and Data Governance teams.

• Help define roles, ownership, and stewardship models for value stream data.

• Contribute to data quality monitoring and remediation processes.


Testing, Cutover & Hypercare

• Support functional and integrated testing with a strong focus on data accuracy.

• Validate business scenarios using migrated and created data.

• Support cutover planning and execution from a data perspective.

• Provide post-go-live support and stabilization.


Required Qualifications

Experience

• 5+ years of SAP functional experience with strong data focus.

• Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA (greenfield preferred).

• Proven involvement in large-scale, global ERP implementations.

• Deep understanding of value stream business processes and related data objects.

• Experience supporting data migration, cleansing, and validation.


Technical & Functional Skills

• Strong knowledge of SAP master data objects (e.g., Material, Vendor/Business

Partner, BOM, Routings, Pricing, Customer, etc.).

• Understanding of S/4HANA data model changes vs. ECC.

• Experience working with SAP MDG or similar governance tools preferred.

• Familiarity with data migration tools (e.g., SAP Migration Cockpit, LVM, ETL tools).

• Ability to read and interpret functional specs and data models.


Soft Skills

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

• Ability to work across global, cross-functional teams.

• Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Comfortable operating in a fast-paced transformation environment.


Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in manufacturing, building materials, or asset-intensive industries.

• Prior role as Functional Data Lead or Data Domain Lead.

• Experience defining global templates and harmonized data models.

• Knowledge of data quality tools and metrics.

title: Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer
description:
Position Summary

CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.

CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.

Essential Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.

The successful candidate will:

  • Become very proficient with CMG's software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
  • Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
  • Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
  • Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
  • Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
  • Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
  • Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.

The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.

Education

Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.

Knowledge & Skills

  • This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
  • Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
  • Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
  • Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
  • Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
  • Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
  • Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
  • Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
  • Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.

Experience

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.

No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we're reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you'll hear from us!

We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.

About Us

Innovators in Simulation Technology

CMG (TSX:CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. CMG is headquartered in Calgary, AB, with offices in Houston, London, Dubai, Bogota, Rio de Janeiro, Bengaluru, and Kuala Lumpur. For more information, please visit

Você toma ações consistentes para desenvolver novas habilidades. Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo. title: International Buyer
description:
General Description

The Buyer will be responsible for sourcing, purchasing, and assisting in the management of the inventory for the landing gear MRO operations. This role will require a high level of attention to detail, an understanding of the aerospace industry, and the ability to work effectively with vendors, suppliers, and internal teams to ensure timely delivery of materials, components, and parts for maintenance and repair services.

Detailed Description

Procurement of Materials & Parts:

  • Source and purchase materials, components, and parts required for landing gear MRO operations.
  • Evaluate and select suppliers based on quality, cost, lead times, and reliability.
  • Ensure all purchases meet the required specifications and are compliant with industry standards and regulations (e.g., FAA, EASA).

Inventory Management:

  • Assist in the maintenance of optimal inventory levels with warehouse team to support continuous MRO operations while minimizing excess stock and potential obsolescence.
  • Help warehouse team if necessary, in the tracking and monitoring of the stock usage, reordering materials and components as necessary.

Supplier Relationship Management:

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers and vendors to ensure high-quality products and timely deliveries.
  • Negotiate pricing, terms, and conditions with suppliers to ensure competitive sourcing and cost savings.

Quality Assurance & Compliance:

  • Work closely with the quality control and engineering teams to ensure that all materials and parts purchased meet the required standards for safety and performance.
  • Monitor and address any quality issues, returns, or discrepancies with suppliers.

Data Entry & Reporting:

  • Maintain accurate records of all purchasing transactions, including purchase orders, invoices, and delivery schedules.
  • Prepare regular procurement reports to track spending, inventory levels, and supplier performance.

Collaboration & Cross-functional Support:

  • Collaborate with maintenance, engineering, and other departments to identify material needs and ensure procurement aligns with operational requirements.
  • Provide support to project teams by ensuring the timely availability of materials for scheduled landing gear maintenance projects.

Cost Control:

  • Monitor and control procurement costs to meet budget targets and contribute to cost-saving initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvements and cost efficiencies in procurement activities.

Qualification Minimum Requirements

Work Experience:

At least 3-5 years of experience in procurement or purchasing, ideally in an aerospace, MRO, or manufacturing environment.

Knowledge of landing gear systems, aerospace components, and regulatory requirements (FAA, EASA) is a significant advantage

Educational:

Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, Business, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field preferred.

Fluent/advanced English

Technical Skills:

Proficient in procurement software and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, etc.).

Knowledge of inventory management systems and ERP tools is a plus. (Oracle and quantum)

Soft Skills:

Strong negotiation and communication skills.

Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

title: Business Development Specialist
description:
We are seeking an ambitious and results-driven Business Development Manager specialized in engineering services to join our team in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. This role is essential for expanding our footprint in the engineering sector, driving new client acquisition, and strengthening strategic partnerships across Brazil's key industries such as oil & gas, infrastructure, energy, manufacturing, and construction.

You will focus on selling a range of engineering solutions including design, consulting, project management, EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction), technical staffing, and specialized engineering services. If you have a strong network in Brazil's engineering ecosystem and a proven ability to win complex, high-value contracts, this is your opportunity to play a pivotal role in our growth in one of Latin America's most dynamic markets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and develop new business opportunities in the engineering services sector across Brazil, with a primary focus on Rio de Janeiro and surrounding regions.
  • Prospect and qualify leads through targeted outreach, industry events, referrals, and digital channels (LinkedIn, sector-specific networks).
  • Build and maintain long-term relationships with key decision-makers in oil & gas companies, infrastructure developers, industrial manufacturers, energy firms, and government-related entities.
  • Develop tailored proposals and solutions that address clients' engineering challenges.
  • Lead the full sales cycle: from initial contact, needs assessment, and technical presentations to contract negotiation and deal closure.
  • Collaborate with engineering, delivery, and technical teams to ensure proposals are competitive and aligned with client requirements.
  • Track market trends, competitor activity, regulatory changes, and upcoming projects (e.g., via ANP, IBAMA, public tenders) to inform strategy.
  • Achieve and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets for engineering services contracts.
  • Represent the company at industry events, trade shows (e.g., Rio Oil & Gas, OTC Brazil), and professional associations in Rio and São Paulo.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Petroleum, or related) or Business Administration. MBA or postgraduate studies are a plus.
  • 5+ years of experience in B2B business development or sales within the engineering services sector (consulting, design, EPC, technical outsourcing, etc.).
  • Proven track record of winning and closing high-value engineering contracts (ideally > R$1M).
  • Strong existing network in Brazil's engineering market, particularly in Rio de Janeiro (oil & gas, energy, infrastructure sectors highly desirable).
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a bonus). Excellent presentation and negotiation skills.
  • Familiarity with public and private tender processes in Brazil
  • Proficiency in CRM tools

  • Self-starter with strong hunter mentality, capable of working independently in a target-driven environment.

Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Análise e solução: Atuar na análise inicial de problemas e novas implementações, propondo soluções e depurando sistemas em cenários complexos.

Requisitos essenciais (Obrigatórios):

Experiência consolidada (mínimo 5 anos ) em desenvolvimento, arquitetura ou liderança técnica.

Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática em C# .NET (Core e Framework) e Angular.

Sólidos conhecimentos em Modelagem de Banco de Dados (preferencialmente SQL Server) e linguagem SQL.

Experiência em metodologias ágeis e tradicionais de desenvolvimento.

Vivência anterior atuando como interface direta com usuários ou áreas de negócio (levantamento de requisitos, definição de escopo).

Inglês Intermediário para leitura e escrita de documentação técnica.

Vivência com ambientes de containers (preferencialmente OpenShift, Docker ou Kubernetes ).

Conhecimento em Arquitetura de TI e Integração de Sistemas.

Pós-graduação na área de Tecnologia.

  • Acting as a trusted senior contributor, helping to scale processes, shape workflows, and ensure consistency, quality, and efficiency across projects.
